channel.title: Cadence 步频 — PT Research Signal
channel.description: Daily curated physical therapy & rehab research for clinicians. AI-scored signal from 50 sources.

item.title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline for Physical Therapist Management After TKA
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has published an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management after total knee arthroplasty (TKA), recommending new treatments and pain management tools.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Structured exercise training for fatigue management in multiple sclerosis: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
item.description: An umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses synthesized evidence on structured exercise training for fatigue in people with multiple sclerosis, comparing effects across exercise modalities and fatigue instruments.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
item.description: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has released a revised clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, based on a systematic review of current scientific literature, featuring 20 recommendations.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Measurements and management of multiple sclerosis-related fatigue: an umbrella review and meta-analysis.
item.description: An umbrella review and meta-analysis of 46 systematic reviews found that exercise provides the most consistent benefit for MS-related fatigue, with aerobic training showing a modest but reliable reduction (SMD -0.32).
item.author: PubMed

item.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
item.description: A machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke was externally validated in an independent Danish prospective cohort, demonstrating its clinical reliability beyond its initial development cohort.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A single-center RCT (n=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program to conventional physiotherapy for rotator cuff-related shoulder pain improved pain and function over 12 weeks, but did not significantly affect fear-avoidance beliefs or healthcare utilization.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
item.description: An economic evaluation alongside a multicenter cluster RCT (n=139) found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA) combining prognostic risk stratification with digital health was cost-effective compared to usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (n=29) found that an asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home-based pulmonary rehabilitation program was feasible and effective for patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis on background antifibrotic therapy.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Complete Guide to Clean Claims for Rehab Therapy Billing
item.description: This guide by WebPT provides a complete overview of the claims creation process to help rehabilitation therapy clinics achieve clean claims and reduce denials.
item.author: WebPT

item.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
item.description: A double-blind RCT (N=56) found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability in adults with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, compared to sham rTMS plus VR over 8 weeks.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
item.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) found that hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis provides superior short-term pain relief over corticosteroid injection or placebo, but long-term outcomes (12-24 weeks) are comparable to physical therapy.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effectiveness of an individualised swimming and education programme for chronic low back pain (EduSwim): a randomised controlled trial.
item.description: This is a protocol for a randomized controlled trial (EduSwim) to assess the effectiveness of an individualized swimming and education program, delivered via telehealth, compared to education alone for chronic non-specific low back pain.
item.author: PubMed

item.title: Effect of resistance, balance, and aerobic training on strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
item.description: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that resistance, balance, and aerobic training significantly improve strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia.
item.author: BMC Geriatrics

item.title: AI Scribes in Physical Therapy Practices
item.description: An APTA article explores the use of AI-enabled ambient scribe technology in physical therapy practices, discussing what PTs and PTAs need to know for implementation.
item.author: APTA

item.title: First trial confirms swimming reduces disability from chronic back pain
item.description: The EduSwim clinical trial, an eight-week individualized physiotherapist-guided swimming and education program, significantly improved function and pain in individuals with chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
item.author: Medical Dialogues

item.title: American Physical Therapy Association: APTA Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series (2026)
item.description: APTA's Health Policy and Payment team will provide an overview of the most significant federal regulatory and commercial payer policy updates for 2026, offering critical insights for physical therapists.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Proposed '27 Home Health Rule: 2.4% Increase Likely Reduced by PDGM Adjustments
item.description: CMS's proposed 2027 Home Health Rule estimates a 2.4% payment increase, but temporary PDGM adjustments are likely to result in lower total payments for home health agencies, with comments due by August 31, 2026.
item.author: APTA

item.title: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility PPS
item.description: CMS issued the FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Prospective Payment System proposed rule, proposing updates to Medicare payment policies and rates, with comments due by June 1.
item.author: CMS

item.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
item.description: A randomized controlled trial (N=45) found that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months compared to device-aided therapy alone.
item.author: PubMed
